items.review_rationale: Read norm open ball with chosen normed space, center and positive radius, strict inequality of norm displacement.

references.context: Length of difference from center a to vector v in specified norm.
Subset of all v with norm(v−a)<r.

references.phrase: open norm balls are metric open balls
references.disposition: Norm induces metric d(v,a)=∥v−a∥ for this structure.

items.review_rationale: Read adapted real-valued continuous-time stochastic process as measurable at time t relative to corresponding filtration sigma-algebra.

references.context: Increasing family of sub-sigma-algebras indexed by all nonnegative real times t.
All Borel preimages of X_t belong to information sigma-algebra at corresponding time t.

references.disposition: Continuous indexing t does not mean sample paths t↦X_t are continuous.

items.review_rationale: Read adapted discrete-time stochastic process as each X_n measurable relative to corresponding filtration F_n at all nonnegative integer times.

references.context: Preimages of all Borel sets under X_n belong to time-n sigma-algebra F_n.

references.phrase: no anticipation of later sigma-algebra information
references.disposition: Adaptedness requires each current observation measurable using available current information.

items.review_rationale: Read conditional expectation given sub-sigma-algebra as integrable G-measurable variable matching integrals of X on every event A in G, unique only almost surely.

references.phrase: integrability of real random variable X and Z
references.context: Expectation of absolute value finite under P.
Preimages of Borel real sets lie in G.
For each A∈G, ∫_A Z dP=∫_A X dP.

references.disposition: It is determined only up to almost-sure equality; an arbitrary representative satisfying both conditions counts.
